title: Reported narrow vertical source boxes produce tiny translated lettering
symptom: A user reported source text bounding boxes that are tall and narrow; fitting horizontal translations into the same width causes unreadably small text.
user_impact: The user must manually adjust region geometry or lettering to achieve readable manga pages.

steps: Issue proposes expanding the text box toward the speech bubble, with caveats for sound-effect lettering.

remaining_question: Which source scripts and page layouts cause the geometry failure in the latest release?
verification_plan: Test licensed vertical JP/CN bubble fixtures; compare text fit using source-text bounding box versus speech-bubble geometry.
